items.title: Hold an Arvada business license
items.description: Business licenses are free and do not expire (food trucks and short-term rentals renew annually); you keep the license active by filing the assigned sales and use tax returns.

items.title: Hold an Aurora business license
items.authority: City of Aurora Tax and Licensing Division
items.description: Any business operating in Aurora or with employees there needs a city business license, one per location. The license covers two years from issuance and establishes sales, use, occupational privilege and lodger's tax filing roles.

items.title: Hold and renew Boulder business licenses
items.authority: City of Boulder Tax and Licensing
items.description: Business licenses are issued site by site, applied for and renewed through the Boulder Online Tax System; businesses also hold a sales tax account in good standing.

items.title: Renew Centennial sales tax license or business registration
items.description: Every active business needs either a Retail Sales Tax License or a Business Registration (one, not both); both are biennial and expire December 31 of the second calendar year.
items.deadline: December 31 of the second calendar year

items.title: Hold Colorado Springs sales tax license
items.authority: City of Colorado Springs Sales Tax Office
items.description: Businesses selling or leasing at retail in the city need a city sales tax license (no fee since September 1, 2023). Licenses expire every odd year on December 31 and are renewed online only.
items.deadline: Expires December 31 of every odd year

items.title: Obtain Denver sales and use tax license
items.authority: Denver Department of Finance, Treasury Division
items.description: Denver is a home-rule city and administers its own sales and use tax separately from the state.

items.title: Withhold and remit Denver Occupational Privilege Tax (OPT)
items.authority: Denver Department of Finance, Treasury Division
items.description: Employers and employees pay a monthly occupational privilege tax for work performed in Denver.

items.title: Hold a Fort Collins sales and use tax license
items.authority: City of Fort Collins Sales Tax Office
items.description: The city's sales and use tax license serves as its business license, with no fee; each location needs its own, and a home occupation license is separate.

note: A two-year city business license is described by third-party sources only; the city's own renewal terms were not confirmed.
City sources describe both a December 31 license expiration (renewals by February 28) and a two-year sales tax license; which applies was not confirmed.

items.title: Obtain a Pueblo sales and use tax license
items.authority: City of Pueblo Finance Department, Sales Tax Division
items.description: Businesses with a Pueblo location start routing through the city portal, then pay fees and apply for the sales and use tax license; returns are due the 20th of the month after the period.

items.title: Hold a Thornton sales and use tax business license
items.authority: City of Thornton Sales Tax Division
items.description: All businesses in Thornton need a city sales and use tax business license, free of charge and with no annual renewal; a certificate of occupancy is also required for locations.

items.title: Renew Westminster business license
items.authority: City of Westminster City Clerk and Sales Tax Division
items.description: Business and sales tax licenses renew annually through the online portal at no fee for commercial locations; a reminder email goes 60 days before expiration.
